Metadata.Title: The Order 1886
Metadata.Name: Resolution: 540p (extreme performance)
Metadata.Note: Takes the game's own 720p display path and sets its render size to 960x540. Original bytes are checked, so other builds are left unchanged. Select one resolution patch only.
Metadata.Author: Bachata S4

Metadata.Title: The Order 1886
Metadata.Name: Resolution: 360p (ultra performance)
Metadata.Note: Takes the game's own 720p display path and sets its render size to 640x360. Softest image, most GPU headroom. Original bytes are checked, so other builds are left unchanged. Select one resolution patch only.
Metadata.Author: Bachata S4

Metadata.Title: The Order 1886
Metadata.Name: Disable Cloth Simulation
Metadata.Note: Turns on the game's own -disablecloth startup option, which disables cloth simulation on all characters. Coats and capes stop moving. Original bytes are checked, so other builds are left unchanged.
Metadata.Author: Bachata S4

Metadata.Title: The Order 1886
Metadata.Name: Disable Motion Blur
Metadata.Note: Forces the renderer onto its native motion-blur bypass/pass-through path before the Motion Blur pass chain.
Metadata.Author: erickmendes22

Metadata.Title: The Order 1886
Metadata.Name: Disable Depth of Field
Metadata.Note: Forces the renderer onto its native depth-of-field bypass/pass-through path before the Depth of Field renderer.
Metadata.Author: erickmendes22

Metadata.Title: The Order 1886
Metadata.Name: Disable Bloom
Metadata.Note: Skips the Bloom render block and resumes at its native end-of-pass marker/cleanup path.
Metadata.Author: erickmendes22

Metadata.Title: The Order 1886
Metadata.Name: Disable Lens Flares
Metadata.Note: Skips the lens-flare render block and resumes at the following native post-process path.
